title: Delivery to a separate app, one synthetic route
route_fixture: Map-selected synthetic Berlin points; live Valhalla route, 1277.78 m
limitations: One test app, one phone, one route, one run, through LocationManager and the GPS provider. Says nothing about apps using Google Play services, or apps that reject mock locations.
deviations: The observer source was uncommitted at the time of the run; it is committed with this evidence. The observer started 4.39 s after RouteMock, so it missed the first 42.4 m, as the protocol expected. The mark came 3.40 s after the Stop tap.
